description.en:
Shows an emotion icon above a character's head: an icon model (data/chr/model/menu/ev_icn01.xc, up to 15 at a time, reused once finished) plays the given motion, e.g. ビックリ01 (surprise), 汗02 (sweat), ムカッ01 (anger), 疑問01 (question), attached to the head bone c_c3.
Optionally it also plays a motion on the character itself (third argument, with its mode and transition frames). The sixth argument (default true) is stored on the icon; its effect was not traced.
Motion to play on the character.

Handle of the icon.
null if the character handle is not positive, the icon name is missing, no icon could be made, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: A surprised reaction (real usage, from ev42010600.nut; the Shift-JIS icon name is replaced by a variable here)
